detailLevels.label: Concise
detailLevels.guidance: Keep each prompt tight and immediately usable - roughly 40-80 words, no section headings, no filler.

detailLevels.label: Balanced
detailLevels.guidance: Use 3-5 short labelled sections per prompt and roughly 120-200 words. Detailed enough to be specific, short enough to paste anywhere.

detailLevels.label: Highly detailed
detailLevels.guidance: Use 5-8 labelled sections per prompt and roughly 250-400 words. Cover edge cases, constraints, tone and technical parameters.

promptTypes.label: Auto-detect
promptTypes.description: Let the AI work out what kind of prompt fits best.
promptTypes.guidance: First infer what the user is actually trying to make from their idea - an image, a video, written copy, code, a chatbot persona, a business document, a lesson, and so on. State the detected type at the start of each prompt's Concept line, then write the prompt using the conventions of that medium.

promptTypes.label: Image
promptTypes.description: Stills for Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion and friends.
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts for an image generator. Cover subject, composition and framing, art style, lighting, colour palette, mood, level of detail and render quality. Include camera and lens language where it helps. Never describe the image as if narrating a story - describe it as a visual specification.

promptTypes.label: Portrait transform
promptTypes.description: Restyle or transform a person's photo.
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts that transform an existing portrait. Preserve the subject's identity, facial structure and likeness explicitly in every variation, then specify the new style, wardrobe, setting, lighting and post-processing. Always add an instruction to keep the face unaltered and natural.

promptTypes.label: Video
promptTypes.description: Clips for Sora, Veo, Runway, Kling.
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts for a video generator. Cover the shot sequence, camera movement, subject action over time, pacing, duration, lighting continuity, aspect ratio and mood. Describe motion explicitly - what changes between the first and last frame.

promptTypes.label: Writing
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts that brief an AI writer. Specify the role it should adopt, target audience, tone of voice, structure, length, formatting and what to avoid. Include a concrete success criterion for the finished piece.

promptTypes.label: Code
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts for a coding assistant. Specify the language and version, framework, the exact task, input and output contracts, error handling, performance and security constraints, and the expected deliverable (full file, diff, or explanation). Ask for tests where relevant.

promptTypes.label: Chatbot persona
promptTypes.guidance: Write system prompts that define an AI assistant. Cover identity and role, scope and boundaries, tone, response format, how to handle unknowns and refusals, and a few behavioural examples. Write in the second person addressed to the assistant.

promptTypes.label: Business
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts that produce professional business output. Specify the business context, stakeholders, objective, deliverable format, level of formality and any metrics or frameworks to apply.

promptTypes.label: Marketing & social
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts that produce marketing output. Specify the platform and its format limits, the target audience and their pain point, the hook, the call to action, the brand voice and any hashtag or character constraints.

promptTypes.label: SEO
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts for SEO work. Specify the primary and secondary keywords, search intent, target word count, heading structure, internal linking, metadata requirements and readability target. Require natural keyword use, never stuffing.

promptTypes.label: Education
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts that produce teaching material. Specify the learner's level and prior knowledge, the learning objective, the explanation approach, worked examples, checks for understanding and common misconceptions to pre-empt.

promptTypes.label: Design & UI
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts for design work. Specify the deliverable, brand personality, colour and typography direction, layout and spacing, accessibility requirements and the format the output should be delivered in.

promptTypes.label: Productivity
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts that produce a practical workflow or plan. Specify the current situation, the desired outcome, constraints such as time and tools, and require concrete, ordered, actionable steps rather than general advice.

promptTypes.label: Art style
promptTypes.description: Work in the voice of a style or movement.
promptTypes.guidance: Write prompts that reproduce a specific artistic style. Name the defining visual motifs, techniques, textures, palette and historical context of the style, and describe how the subject is rendered through it.

platforms.label: Any / not sure
platforms.guidance: Write platform-neutral prompts in plain prose that work well in any modern AI tool. Do not use vendor-specific flags or syntax.

platforms.label: ChatGPT
platforms.guidance: Conversational model. Favour a clear role assignment, structured markdown instructions and an explicit output format. No special syntax.

platforms.label: Gemini
platforms.guidance: Conversational model with strong multimodal and long-context handling. Favour explicit structure and step-by-step instructions. No special syntax.

platforms.label: Claude
platforms.guidance: Conversational model that responds well to XML-style tags for sections, a stated role, and explicit reasoning instructions.

platforms.label: Midjourney
platforms.guidance: Image generator. Use dense comma-separated descriptive phrases rather than full sentences, and end with parameters such as --ar 16:9 --style raw --v 6 where appropriate. Avoid negation words; use --no instead.

platforms.label: DALL-E 3
platforms.guidance: Image generator that prefers natural, descriptive full sentences over keyword soup. No parameter flags. Be explicit about text rendering if text must appear.

platforms.label: Stable Diffusion
platforms.guidance: Image generator. Use weighted comma-separated tags, and supply a separate negative prompt listing artefacts to avoid.

platforms.label: Flux
platforms.guidance: Image generator that handles long natural-language descriptions and in-image text well. Write flowing descriptive prose.

platforms.label: Leonardo AI
platforms.guidance: Image generator. Use descriptive phrases plus explicit style and quality modifiers.

platforms.label: Sora
platforms.guidance: Video generator. Describe the shot cinematically, including camera movement, subject motion and how the scene evolves across the clip.

platforms.label: Veo
platforms.guidance: Video generator. Describe the scene, camera work, motion and audio atmosphere in natural prose, and state the duration and aspect ratio.

platforms.label: Runway
platforms.guidance: Video generator. Keep motion instructions concise and concrete, and specify camera movement explicitly.

platforms.label: Kling
platforms.guidance: Video generator. Describe subject motion and camera movement separately and keep the scene focused on one continuous action.

platforms.label: GitHub Copilot
platforms.guidance: In-editor coding assistant. Write prompts as precise implementation instructions with file and function context.

platforms.label: Cursor
platforms.guidance: Agentic coding editor. Write prompts that state the goal, the files in scope, the constraints and the acceptance criteria.
